name: 李文亞
objective:
介紹含碳化合物的命名、結構與性質的基本概念。課程重點在烷、烯、炔類、芳香族與醇類相關的反應機構、合成、立體化學、化學分析及儀器分析方法。

This course introduces the basic concepts of naming, structure, and properties of carbon-containing compounds. The focus of the course lies in the reaction mechanisms, synthesis, stereochemistry, chemical analysis, and instrumental analysis methods related to alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, aromatic compounds, and alcohols.
課程進度(1-16週):
Syllabus
1 Introduction to Organic Chemistry
2 Chemical Structures and Bonding
3 Alkanes
4 Alkanes and Cycloalkanes
5 Alkane Reactions and Synthesis
6 Alkenes
7 Alkene Reactions and Synthesis
8 Alkynes
9 Alkyne Reactions and Synthesis
10 Midterm Exam
11 Aromatic Compounds
12 Stereoisomerism
13 Organic Halides
14 Alcohols, Phenols, and Thiols
15 NMR
16 NMR
17 Final Report
18 Final Exam
